description: This file defines a `CircularByteBuffer` class, which implements a thread-unsafe circular buffer for bytes with methods for adding and removing bytes, as well as managing internal state.

classes.name: CircularByteBuffer
classes.description: A thread-unsafe circular buffer for bytes, supporting basic operations like put, get, clear, size, and length.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the buffer to empty state.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total capacity of the buffer.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the current number of bytes stored in the buffer.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the next byte from the buffer, throws EOFException if empty.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a byte to the buffer, throws BufferOverflowException if full.
